goal: Prevent node database corruption by aborting commits when writing block or undo data to disk fails
Avoids marking blocks as durable when their underlying data was never safely flushed
agreement: Broad support with multiple reviewers verifying the fix locally (arejula27, optout21, pzafonte)
Support noting it prevents corruption when block data is on a separate drive (mzumsande)
Tested in the context of kernel pruning work (pzafonte)
Open question on whether flushing should succeed on retry after shutdown was requested (arejula27)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it prevents chainstate metadata and coins cache corruption when disk flushes fail
Protects node operators against state divergence if disk syncing fails on separate block storage
